value.description: This field contains the data structure that is being wrapped by the partial matcher

partialMatcherValueType.description:
Designates the type of partial matcher. This is necessary instead of relying on type().typeName() because type
names are not preserved when nested data structures are passed into a field of 'any' or 'json'
